info.title: Lodestar API
info.description: Agentic SEO operations API. All routes are under /api/v1. Write endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Browser sessions use an httpOnly cookie plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header; API clients may use `Authorization: Bearer`.
